title: T 形反馈网络的反相放大器
statement: 反相放大器的反馈支路是由 R2、R3、R4 组成的 T 形网络。u_s = 0.2 V，R1 = 10 kΩ，R2 = R3 = 50 kΩ，R4 = 10 kΩ，运放为理想运放。
用结点电压法求结点 m 的电位 u_m、R4 中的电流 i4（参考方向见图）、输出电压 u_o。

questions.explain: i4 = (u_m − 0)/R4 = −1/10k = −0.1 mA，实际方向从地流向 m。

questions.ask: 若改用普通反相放大器（只有一个反馈电阻 Rf）得到相同的放大倍数，Rf 应为多少？
questions.explain: u_o/u_s = −7/0.2 = −35 = −Rf/R1 → Rf = 350 kΩ。T 形网络用 50 kΩ、10 kΩ 这样较小的电阻就实现了很大的放大倍数：u_o/u_s = −(R2 + R3 + R2R3/R4)/R1。

hints: 反相端 n 是虚地，对 n 列结点方程（虚断）可直接求出 u_m。
再对 m 列结点方程，未知量只剩 u_o。注意运放输出端不能列 KCL（输出电流未知）。
solution: 设地为参考点，u_n = 0（虚短）。运放输出端电流未知，所以只对 n、m 两个结点列方程。

en.title: Inverting amplifier with a T feedback network
statement: The feedback path of this inverting amplifier is a T network made of R2, R3 and R4. v_s = 0.2 V, R1 = 10 kΩ, R2 = R3 = 50 kΩ, R4 = 10 kΩ; the op-amp is ideal.
Using nodal analysis, find the potential v_m of node m, the current i4 in R4 (reference as drawn) and the output voltage v_o.

questions.explain: Node n (virtual ground, virtual open): v_s/R1 = (0 − v_m)/R2 → 0.02 mA = −v_m/50k → v_m = −1 V.
i4 = (v_m − 0)/R4 = −1/10k = −0.1 mA; it actually flows from ground up into m.

questions.ask: An ordinary inverting amplifier (a single feedback resistor Rf) with the same gain would need Rf = ?
questions.explain: v_o/v_s = −7/0.2 = −35 = −Rf/R1 → Rf = 350 kΩ. The T network reaches a large gain with modest resistors such as 50 kΩ and 10 kΩ: v_o/v_s = −(R2 + R3 + R2R3/R4)/R1.

hints: The inverting node n is a virtual ground; the node equation at n (virtual open) gives v_m directly.
Then write the node equation at m, where only v_o is unknown. Don't write KCL at the op-amp output — its output current is unknown.
solution: Take ground as reference; v_n = 0 (virtual short). The op-amp output current is unknown, so write node equations only at n and m.
